0.1.1.en: Switched to correct source for available energy capability.

0.1.2.en: Add inisghts to available energy capability

0.2.0.en: Add discovery instead of manual IP input

0.3.0.en: Add grid & solar sensors. Fix cumulative energy capabiliyt for battery. Add app/driver images and icons.

0.5.0.en: Breaking change due to capability switch for avaialble energy. Fix translations for custom measures.

0.5.2.en: Add community id, further tweaks to discovery logic

0.5.4.en: Handle batteries with two battery packs correctly

0.6.0.en: Release Candidate (POSSIBLY BREAKING CHANGE): Added battery status inc. When/And flow cards. Reworked fetching logic. Polling interval setting now moved to app settings.

0.6.1.en: Tweaks to icons. Fix Homey Pro 2016-2019. Add read-only settings to battery.

0.6.4.en: Added 3rd decimal for energy import/export. Increased fault tolerance in fetch.

0.6.5.en: Improved error handling for failing data requests.

1.0.1.en: Fix for non-working AND card. Make battery settings prettier.

1.1.0.en: Changed behavior of charge/discharge to align with homey guidelines and work better in homey energy. Power & Target Power values are now negated (-power, -targetPower). No change to discharge/charge states or anything else.

1.2.0.en: Added UI picker for Battery control mode. Added flow cards for battery control mode, and setting/clearing schedules.

1.2.1.en: Added support for manually setting battery control mode and local schedules.

1.3.0.en: Updated copy for current charge/discharge card to refer to planned charging. Added two new flow cards for charge now/discharge now.

1.4.0.en: Add support for cumulative import/export for homey energy

1.4.1.en: Minor fixes due to changing Homevolt data structure.

1.4.2.en: Increased fault tollerance with older firmware versions.

1.4.3.en: Tweak for dual Homevolt setup (max charge limit 12kW).

1.5.0.en: Updated to use homey's latest native features for home batteries. Added manual IP pairing. Numerous bug fixes.

1.6.0.en: New Flow cards for charging and discharging relative to the grid connection point, both immediately and over a planned time window. Fixed the planned charging/discharging cards, which were sending an option the battery does not accept and therefore failed.

1.7.0.en: Optional anonymous usage statistics, off unless you turn them on - either from the checkbox when adding a battery, or under Settings > Privacy. No battery readings, IP addresses, serial numbers, wifi details or device names are ever sent. Also fixed the battery reporting itself to Homey Energy as a whole-home meter in some setups, and improved detection of an unreachable battery.

1.7.1.en: Capability cleanup for Target power capabilities. Legacy capqbility (from before Homey supported this natively) renamed to Target Power (legacy) and now stops writing new values.  New Target Power capability (Target Power) updated to read values when in Partner mode, and write values only when in Homey (local) mode. Minor tweaks to analytics introduced in 1.7.0.

1.7.2.en: Improvements to the optional anonymous usage statistics. Nothing changes in how the app reads or controls your battery.

1.7.4.en: Fixed an IP address changed with "Repair" reverting to the old one after the app or Homey restarted. If you have repaired a device before, repair it once more after updating. Updated the Homey SDK.

1.8.0.en: Supports Homevolts with sign-in and HTTPS turned on. Both are detected when you add or repair a device, and you are only asked for the device password (the QR code on the device) or an access token when sign-in is on. One entry covers the battery, grid sensor and solar devices. If sign-in was turned on by a firmware update, enter the password or token in the device settings under Sign-in. Homevolts without sign-in work as before. A rejected password is never retried, so Homey cannot lock you out of the Homevolt's web interface.
1.8.0.sv: Stöd för Homevolt med inloggning och HTTPS påslaget. Båda upptäcks när du lägger till eller reparerar en enhet, och du blir bara ombedd att ange enhetens lösenord (QR-koden på enheten) eller en åtkomsttoken när inloggning är på. En inmatning gäller för batteriet, nätsensorn och solenheterna. Om en firmwareuppdatering slog på inloggning anger du lösenordet eller token i enhetens inställningar under Inloggning. Homevolt utan inloggning fungerar som tidigare. Ett nekat lösenord skickas aldrig igen, så Homey kan inte låsa dig ute från Homevolts webbgränssnitt.
1.8.0.de: Unterstützt Homevolts mit aktivierter Anmeldung und HTTPS. Beides wird beim Hinzufügen oder Reparieren eines Geräts erkannt, und nach dem Gerätepasswort (dem QR-Code auf dem Gerät) oder einem Zugriffstoken wird nur gefragt, wenn die Anmeldung aktiv ist. Eine Eingabe gilt für Batterie, Netzsensor und Solargeräte. Wurde die Anmeldung durch ein Firmware-Update aktiviert, gib das Passwort oder Token in den Geräteeinstellungen unter Anmeldung ein. Homevolts ohne Anmeldung funktionieren wie bisher. Ein abgelehntes Passwort wird nie erneut gesendet, sodass Homey dich nicht aus der Weboberfläche des Homevolt aussperren kann.
1.8.0.fr: Prise en charge des Homevolt avec connexion et HTTPS activés. Les deux sont détectés lors de l'ajout ou de la réparation d'un appareil, et le mot de passe de l'appareil (le code QR sur l'appareil) ou un jeton d'accès n'est demandé que si la connexion est activée. Une seule saisie vaut pour la batterie, le capteur réseau et les appareils solaires. Si une mise à jour du firmware a activé la connexion, saisissez le mot de passe ou le jeton dans les réglages de l'appareil, sous Connexion. Les Homevolt sans connexion fonctionnent comme avant. Un mot de passe refusé n'est jamais renvoyé, pour que Homey ne puisse pas vous bloquer l'accès à l'interface web du Homevolt.
1.8.0.es: Compatibilidad con Homevolt con inicio de sesión y HTTPS activados. Ambos se detectan al añadir o reparar un dispositivo, y solo se pide la contraseña del dispositivo (el código QR del dispositivo) o un token de acceso cuando el inicio de sesión está activado. Una sola entrada sirve para la batería, el sensor de red y los dispositivos solares. Si una actualización de firmware activó el inicio de sesión, introduce la contraseña o el token en los ajustes del dispositivo, en Inicio de sesión. Los Homevolt sin inicio de sesión funcionan como antes. Una contraseña rechazada nunca se vuelve a enviar, así que Homey no puede bloquearte el acceso a la interfaz web del Homevolt.
1.8.0.nl: Ondersteunt Homevolts met inloggen en HTTPS ingeschakeld. Beide worden herkend bij het toevoegen of repareren van een apparaat, en om het apparaatwachtwoord (de QR-code op het apparaat) of een toegangstoken wordt alleen gevraagd als inloggen aan staat. Eén invoer geldt voor de batterij, de netsensor en de zonne-apparaten. Heeft een firmware-update inloggen ingeschakeld, vul het wachtwoord of token dan in bij de apparaatinstellingen onder Aanmelden. Homevolts zonder inloggen werken zoals voorheen. Een geweigerd wachtwoord wordt nooit opnieuw verstuurd, zodat Homey je niet kan buitensluiten van de webinterface van de Homevolt.
